definitions.gloss: brick construction; brick-built; made of brick
definitions.explanation: A building or structure constructed primarily from bricks, or the method of building with bricks.

examples.japanese: レンガ{造|づく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。

⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦レンガ→レンガ：19408_renga⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧レンガ{造|づく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表的|だいひょうてき}→代表的：05670_daihyouteki⟧な⟦{建築物|けんちくぶつ}→建築物：21292_kenchikubutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse is a representative example of brick construction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧レンガ{造|づく}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洋館|ようかん}→洋館：30736_youkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧⟦{建造物|けんぞうぶつ}→建造物：24301_kenzoubutsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A Western-style brick building constructed in the Meiji era is still carefully preserved as a historic structure.

notes:
A compound of ⟦レンガ→レンガ：19408_renga⟧ (brick) and {造|づく}り (construction, making). The ～{造|づく}り suffix is a productive pattern in Japanese for describing construction types.

Brick buildings are not native to Japanese architecture but were introduced during the ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧ (Meiji era) as part of Western-style modernization. Many iconic brick buildings from this period survive as cultural landmarks, such as {東京駅|とうきょうえき} (Tokyo Station) and the ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦レンガ→レンガ：19408_renga⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧ (Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse).
